hook: Preventable liquidations often occur when network fee spikes price out or delay defensive collateral deposits.
body: This transaction inclusion failure cannot easily spread on Stellar Soroban. Ledger capacity usage is 0.08 with a base fee of 100, keeping submission costs stable when positions require urgent adjustment. However, risk does not drop to zero. With Blend TVL at $157,161,882 and Soroswap TVL at $1,238,140, the structural vulnerability shifts from gas volatility to secondary market depth.
